easyPrerequisites: You control a nontoken Merfolk and at least one additional creature that each have a +1/+1 counter on them.
description:
Activate the nontoken Merfolk using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Merfolk's ability, untapping the other creature.
Activate the other creature using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it, untapping the nontoken Merfolk.
Repeat.
